outcomeNote: An amoraic restriction of the mishna.

segments.he: שֶׁאֵין הָאִשָּׁה קוֹבַעַת לָהּ וֶסֶת עַד שֶׁתִּקְבָּעֶנָּה וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב פָּפָּא: לָא אֲמַרַן אֶלָּא לְמִקְבְּעַהּ, אֲבָל לְמֵיחַשׁ לַהּ בַּחֲדָא זִימְנָא חָיְישָׁא.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «As a woman establishes a fixed» menstrual «cycle only after she establishes it» three times. «Rav Pappa says,» in explanation: «We said» that she must experience bleeding three times «only with regard to establishing» a fixed menstrual cycle, «but with regard to» being «concerned» for a pattern, even «after one time she must be concerned» that this might be the beginning of a fixed pattern.

moves.cueHe: שאין האשה קובעת לה וסת עד שתקבענה
moves.about: the mishna's rule that a cycle is fixed only by three occurrences

moves.cueHe: אמר רב פפא: לא אמרן אלא למקבעה
moves.summary: the three-time rule concerns fixing; concern arises after one

edges.about: the mishna's rule that a cycle is fixed only by three occurrences
